description: Scala combines object tools with functions and strong types. It runs on the Java virtual machine. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Scala CLI. Save each example as lesson.scala and run scala run lesson.scala. These examples use Scala 3 syntax.
versionNote: Examples use Scala 3.3 or later and Scala CLI.
whatYouWillLearn: Match a named choice with Scala
learningObjectives: Handle an absent value with Scala
